champion.name: counterrush-bait-anvil
champion.author: claude
champion.description: Exploits flag-pincer-exploiter's split opening (red move-then-defend at the flag and blue attacking arrive staggered, yellow patrols centre alone, and only green guards its home) and its two all-in reflexes: flag_stolen sends all four of its units to enemy_flag instead of chasing the carrier, and captured sends all four to their_flag again on every score. A three-unit anvil (blue, green, yellow defend our_flag) plus red patrolling centre shreds its staggered raid, its lone yellow and its predictable counter-rushes when they arrive; a pair raid then steals against its lone green home guard and the carrier walks home unchased while the champion counter-rushes into the anvil. Its slow 1200t cheap pulse mostly wastes calls on weakest-regroups-at-centre, so it cannot re-plan inside this strategy's 1500t cheap / 5400t smart cadence on a 32 budget (worst case 15 cheap + 4 smart = 19 calls in the 24000-tick cap, never a hard stop). flag_stolen here is answered by a pair plus nearest chasing the carrier — never the whole squad — flag_dropped is secured by a pair at our_flag instead of a swarm, their_flag_dropped is scooped by pair plus nearest (3 units against its pair alone), we_scored instantly re-raids with a pair against the home its captured reflex just emptied while two hold our flag, and they_scored counter-runs red while the anvil re-forms.

newest.name: pairhammer-clocktrap
newest.author: claude
newest.description: Exploits lonesentryanvil1331233s123-x-lonesentryanvil133123-2 on three counts: (1) its 450t cheap pulse burns its 28-call budget and hard-stops it around tick 11700 in any long match, so a 1500t cheap / 3000t smart pulse on a 40-call budget can never stop inside the 24000-tick cap (max 16 cheap + 6 smart = 22); (2) its opening defends with lone yellow while green patrols centre, so a three-unit opening wave (red runs their_flag then home behind blue and yellow both attacking their_flag) overwhelms yellow 3v1 before green swings home; (3) its reflexes feed losses: unit_down commits its pair to attack their_flag, stripping home further after the first kill, and its we_scored wave sends red and blue as pure unarmed movers. This counter does the opposite after a loss (pair plus idle defend our_flag), answers their theft with a full pair-plus-nearest converge instead of its diluted flag_stolen, shreds its mover wave with a full anvil on they_scored, and times its late smart plans (post-11700) as flag runs against the frozen champion while one unit keeps the home flag.
